name: Dot grid
summary: A grid of dots that swell in waves spreading out from the middle: each kick a ring travelling outward.
credit: After vizz.fm's Dot Grid (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written fresh.
hint: Waves: each dot shows the sound as it was a moment ago, the farther from the middle the longer ago, so every kick spreads out as a ring (the bass sets the size, the highs the colour). Spectrum: distance from the middle is frequency, the lows in the middle.

params.label: Wave speed
params.help: How fast the waves spread, in heights of the frame a second.

params.label: At rest
params.help: How big a dot is in silence, as a share of a full one.
